heading: River levels
intro: This site collects water levels, discharge, forecasts and alert levels for the rivers that flow into the Netherlands, from open sources in the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France, Luxembourg and Switzerland.
not_official: This is not an official warning service. During high water, follow Rijkswaterstaat and your local authorities.
spike_intro: Test page for the self-hosted basemap with 200 test stations. This page never ships to the public site.
beta_banner: Beta: this site is under development. Data may be missing or wrong.
data_unavailable: The data cannot be loaded right now. Please try again later.
app_failed: The page cannot be loaded. Please try again later.
repeated_hour_legend: This hour occurs twice (end of summer time). Which one do you mean?
time_missing: This time does not exist: the clocks went forward an hour (start of summer time).
epoch_note: This site records from {date}; earlier data were fetched from the sources afterwards.
play_reduced_motion: Playback is off because your device asks for reduced motion.
map_no_webgl: This browser cannot show the map (no WebGL2). The stations are listed in the table.
map_fallback: The stations are listed in the table.
data_since_seeded: {date}, loaded in advance (this site records from {epoch})
not_comparable: Every value is shown as its source publishes it, with its own unit and zero (gauge zero, NAP, NN): values from different gauges cannot be compared with each other.
chart_label: The 7 days up to the selected time, {unit}
rivers_licence_lead: The river network is derived from OpenStreetMap and offered under the
rivers_collective: The station measurements are a separate collective database and are not covered by the ODbL.
basis_nl4: RWS Waterinfo legend, not an official warning
forecast_range_note: To the right of ‘now’ the timeline shows official forecasts, up to {time}.
forecast_station_none_note: No forecast is available for this station: the timeline ends at ‘now’.
forecast_estimate_note: estimate: beyond the part the source forecasts itself
forecast_bafu_note: BAFU forecast: the median of a set of model runs; the band shows where the middle half of them lies (25–75 %). Warnings for small and medium rivers are issued by the cantons.
